items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Roy Haynes was a combo drummer. I don't care if he played in the big bands, the swing wasn't there. Wasn'ta blues drummer. Good drummer, though.

ctx.x: What about Roy Haynes? He was a --
Roy Haynes was a combo drummer. I don't care if he played in the big bands, the swing wasn't there. Wasn'ta blues drummer. Good drummer, though.
You felt good about the way Blakey played.
